public_rationale: Marcus offers a tentative characterization of a “new and different and frightening era.” Documented failures to follow correct instructions could substantiate the concern motivating it, but grading those failures alone would replace this statement with a narrower claim. The wording supplies no objective test for the full characterization. Following the reviewers’ objections, this assessment does not convert it into a firm technical assertion.
limitations: No external evidence search was performed because the obstacle is the statement’s testability.
This outcome does not establish whether the underlying concern about LLM reliability is correct.
